svg.text: Angular lifecycle — route, token, interceptor – Visual Guide
Client1 · C04 extra · bootstrap → guard (token) → ngOnInit → interceptor (Bearer) → API
Same visit: route first, then the component, then HTTP.
DI only — do not call HTTP here
clone request, add Bearer from storage
Guard, interceptor, and API — three different moments.
Written at login. Read by guard and interceptor. Cleared at logout.
Guard does not call the interceptor. Interceptor does not create the route.
return !!this.auth.token; // route only — not the API
Guard runs before the component. Interceptor runs on HTTP.
If they say lifecycle, walk these six boxes.
// Guard = may I open this route?
